ios.desc:
ColorID offers an advanced solution for professionals and color enthusiasts. With precision tools, it helps you identify colors from images, live camera, and saved photos on iPhone and iPad. Convert colors seamlessly between HEX, RGB, CMYK, HSV, RAL and Pantone formats, making it an essential tool for designers, artists, and developers.

→ Identify colors instantly and gain full control over your palette.

◉ KEY FEATURES
• Identify colors from images, camera, and screenshots
• Get precise HEX, RGB, CMYK, HSV, RAL and Pantone codes
• Convert colors between multiple formats effortlessly
• Save and organize your favorite colors in a personal library
• Zoom in close, with macro on supported iPhone models
• Analyze any photo or screenshot from the Share menu

◉ COLORBLIND TOOLS
• Made for every type of color vision: protanopia, deuteranopia, tritanopia and achromatopsia
• Simple color names: navy, olive, pink, instead of codes
• Highlight: pick a color and everything else turns gray
• Find: tap a color and every area of the same color stands out
• Correct: makes hard-to-tell colors easier to see, tuned to your type of color vision
• Pattern: every color family gets its own texture, so charts, maps and wires read without telling colors apart

◉ PAINT & COLOR CATALOGS
• Browse 20+ color libraries: leading paint brands like Sherwin-Williams, Benjamin Moore, Behr, Farrow & Ball, PPG — plus RAL and print & ink standards
• Search any catalog by code or name and copy codes in one tap
• Save catalog colors and build brand-true palettes

◉ ADVANCED PALETTE MANAGEMENT
• Generate custom color palettes from any image or photo
• Organize and edit your palette collections with ease
• Export palettes as PNG or PDF files directly to your device
• Create professional color schemes for your projects
• Share palettes across different design platforms

◉ COLOR IDENTIFICATION – 99% ACCURATE
ColorID ensures every color is captured with precision. Whether you're matching brand colors, selecting paint, or working on a design project, ColorID gives you the exact color values you need.

◉ SEAMLESS COLOR MANAGEMENT
ColorID makes working with colors easier than ever. Extract color palettes, analyze shades, and convert between professional color formats in seconds.

◉ SIMPLE YET POWERFUL
ColorID delivers fast and accurate color identification. Its intuitive tools help you work with colors effortlessly while ensuring you always have full control.

◉ EFFORTLESS COLOR CONVERSION
• Easy to Use
